minor.issue: Hits 429 rate-limit ('Demasiadas peticiones, espera 60 segundos') if multiple consecutive logins happen — fine for prod but slows test reruns; consider raising threshold for test accounts.

If the intent is destination-flag UX, when locale is ES it should show '🇺🇸 EN' (and vice-versa). Verify whether main-agent's spec was already implemented as 'current flag' intentionally; otherwise this is a regression.

/api/plans price field is `price_monthly` (not `price`). Document this in API contract so frontends and tests don't drift.
